comment: The pipeline model: each workflow this repository owns, as data, one file per workflow at app/specs/pipeline/workflows/<name>.json, rendered to .github/workflows/<name> by cargo run -q --locked -p xtask -- pipeline --write; xtask pipeline (also in xtask validate) fails on a rendered file that differs, or on a model file this list does not name. In any mapping, "#" gives the comment lines above each key, and "" the comment above a list item. The template's own workflows (template.lock) are not here.
